verdicts.reason: A has a clear top-to-bottom order (headline, window, details) with decent margins, but the event details sit right under the window base with no breathing room, the left-aligned headline and right-aligned details share no common axis with the centred window, and the details text is small. B pushes the headline to about 12px from the left edge, runs the long right-aligned address line nearly into the right edge at a tiny size, strands 'Sunday' on its own line, and leaves a large dead band below the window, so the layout looks cramped at the top and empty at the bottom.
